<?php
/**
 * GraphQL Query Builder - CLI tool for managing encrypted API queries
 * Supports parameterized queries with encrypted credential storage
 */

class EncryptedStore {
    private string $keyFile;
    private string $dataFile;
    
    public function __construct(string $basePath) {
        $this->keyFile = $basePath . '/store.key';
        $this->dataFile = $basePath . '/store.enc';
    }
    
    public function initialize(): void {
        if (!file_exists($this->keyFile)) {
            $key = sodium_crypto_secretbox_keygen();
            file_put_contents($this->keyFile, $key);
            chmod($this->keyFile, 0600);
        }
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): string {
        $key = file_get_contents($this->keyFile);
        $nonce = random_bytes(SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_NONCEBYTES);
        $cipher = sodium_crypto_secretbox($plaintext, $nonce, $key);
        sodium_memzero($key);
        return base64_encode($nonce . $cipher);
    }
    
    public function decrypt(string $encoded): string {
        $key = file_get_contents($this->keyFile);
        $decoded = base64_decode($encoded);
        $nonce = substr($decoded, 0, SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_NONCEBYTES);
        $cipher = substr($decoded, SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_NONCEBYTES);
        $plain = sodium_crypto_secretbox_open($cipher, $nonce, $key);
        sodium_memzero($key);
        if ($plain === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Decryption failed - corrupted store');
        }
        return $plain;
    }
    
    public function saveCredentials(array $creds): void {
        $json = json_encode($creds, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $encrypted = $this->encrypt($json);
        file_put_contents($this->dataFile, $encrypted);
        chmod($this->dataFile, 0600);
    }
    
    public function loadCredentials(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->dataFile)) {
            return [];
        }
        $encrypted = file_get_contents($this->dataFile);
        $json = $this->decrypt($encrypted);
        return json_decode($json, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }
}

class QueryTemplate {
    private string $name;
    private string $body;
    private array $parameterTypes;
    
    public function __construct(string $name, string $body, array $parameterTypes) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->body = $body;
        $this->parameterTypes = $parameterTypes;
    }
    
    public function getName(): string { return $this->name; }
    public function getBody(): string { return $this->body; }
    public function getParameterTypes(): array { return $this->parameterTypes; }
}

class QueryBuilder {
    private array $templates = [];
    private array $typeValidators;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->typeValidators = [
            'ID' => fn($v) => preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $v),
            'Int' => fn($v) => filter_var($v, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) !== false,
            'Float' => fn($v) => filter_var($v, FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT) !== false,
            'Boolean' => fn($v) => in_array(strtolower($v), ['true', 'false']),
            'String' => fn($v) => true,
        ];
    }
    
    public function registerTemplate(QueryTemplate $template): void {
        $this->templates[$template->getName()] = $template;
    }
    
    public function getTemplate(string $name): ?QueryTemplate {
        return $this->templates[$name] ?? null;
    }
    
    /**
     * Builds a query from template with parameter substitution.
     * Uses GraphQL variable syntax for safe parameterization.
     */
    public function buildQuery(string $templateName, array $variables): array {
        $template = $this->getTemplate($templateName);
        if (!$template) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unknown template: $templateName");
        }
        
        $paramTypes = $template->getParameterTypes();
        $sanitizedVars = [];
        
        foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
            if (!isset($paramTypes[$key])) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unknown parameter: $key");
            }
            $type = $paramTypes[$key];
            $baseType = rtrim($type, '!');
            
            if (isset($this->typeValidators[$baseType])) {
                if (!($this->typeValidators[$baseType])($value)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                        "Parameter '$key' failed validation for type '$baseType'"
                    );
                }
            }
            $sanitizedVars[$key] = $this->castValue($value, $baseType);
        }
        
        return [
            'query' => $template->getBody(),
            'variables' => $sanitizedVars,
        ];
    }
    
    private function castValue(string $value, string $type): mixed {
        return match($type) {
            'Int' => (int)$value,
            'Float' => (float)$value,
            'Boolean' => strtolower($value) === 'true',
            'ID', 'String' => $value,
            default => $value,
        };
    }
}

class GraphQLClient {
    private string $endpoint;
    private array $headers;
    
    public function __construct(string $endpoint, string $authToken) {
        $this->endpoint = $endpoint;
        $this->headers = [
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $authToken,
        ];
    }
    
    public function execute(array $payload): array {
        $ch = curl_init($this->endpoint);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($payload),
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $this->headers,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
        ]);
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        if ($httpCode !== 200) {
            throw new RuntimeException("HTTP $httpCode from GraphQL endpoint");
        }
        return json_decode($response, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }
}

/**
 * Inline query mode - allows direct query construction for advanced users.
 * Applies field-level allowlist filtering for safety.
 */
class InlineQueryProcessor {
    private array $allowedRootFields;
    private array $deniedDirectives;
    
    public function __construct(array $allowedRootFields) {
        $this->allowedRootFields = $allowedRootFields;
        $this->deniedDirectives = ['@include', '@skip', '@deprecated'];
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates and normalizes an inline query string.
     * Ensures only allowed root fields are queried.
     */
    public function processInlineQuery(string $operation, string $fields, array $args): string {
        // Validate operation type
        if (!in_array($operation, ['query', 'mutation'], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid operation type');
        }
        
        // Check for denied directives
        foreach ($this->deniedDirectives as $directive) {
            if (stripos($fields, $directive) !== false) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Directive not allowed: ' . $directive);
            }
        }
        
        // Extract root field name and validate against allowlist
        $rootField = $this->extractRootField($fields);
        if (!in_array($rootField, $this->allowedRootFields, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Field not allowed: $rootField");
        }
        
        // Build argument string with proper escaping
        $argString = $this->buildArgString($args);
        
        // Construct the final query
        $query = $operation . ' { ' . $rootField;
        if ($argString) {
            $query .= '(' . $argString . ')';
        }
        
        // Append the selection set from user input
        $selectionSet = $this->extractSelectionSet($fields);
        $query .= ' ' . $selectionSet . ' }';
        
        return $query;
    }
    
    private function extractRootField(string $fields): string {
        // Parse first identifier token as root field
        if (preg_match('/^\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)/', $fields, $m)) {
            return $m[1];
        }
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Cannot parse root field');
    }
    
    private function extractSelectionSet(string $fields): string {
        // Find the selection set (everything in braces)
        $bracePos = strpos($fields, '{');
        if ($bracePos === false) {
            return '{ id }';
        }
        return substr($fields, $bracePos);
    }
    
    private function buildArgString(array $args): string {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($args as $key => $value) {
            // Validate argument name
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/', $key)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Invalid argument name: $key");
            }
            // Escape string values
            $escaped = $this->escapeGraphQLString($value);
            $parts[] = $key . ': "' . $escaped . '"';
        }
        return implode(', ', $parts);
    }
    
    private function escapeGraphQLString(string $value): string {
        // GraphQL string escaping per spec section 2.9.4
        $value = str_replace('\\', '\\\\', $value);
        $value = str_replace('"', '\\"', $value);
        $value = str_replace("\n", '\\n', $value);
        $value = str_replace("\r", '\\r', $value);
        // Note: Unicode escaping handled by JSON transport layer
        return $value;
    }
}

// --- CLI Entry Point ---
function main(array $argv): int {
    $storePath = getenv('GQLCLI_STORE') ?: ($_SERVER['HOME'] . '/.gqlcli');
    
    if (!is_dir($storePath)) {
        mkdir($storePath, 0700, true);
    }
    
    $store = new EncryptedStore($storePath);
    $store->initialize();
    
    $command = $argv[1] ?? 'help';
    
    switch ($command) {
        case 'configure':
            $endpoint = $argv[2] ?? readline('Endpoint: ');
            $token = $argv[3] ?? readline('Auth Token: ');
            $store->saveCredentials([
                'endpoint' => $endpoint,
                'token' => $token,
            ]);
            echo "Credentials stored securely.\n";
            return 0;
            
        case 'query':
            $creds = $store->loadCredentials();
            if (empty($creds)) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "No credentials configured. Run 'configure' first.\n");
                return 1;
            }
            
            $builder = new QueryBuilder();
            $builder->registerTemplate(new QueryTemplate(
                'getUser',
                'query GetUser($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name email } }',
                ['id' => 'ID!']
            ));
            $builder->registerTemplate(new QueryTemplate(
                'listItems',
                'query ListItems($limit: Int, $offset: Int) { items(limit: $limit, offset: $offset) { id title } }',
                ['limit' => 'Int', 'offset' => 'Int']
            ));
            
            $templateName = $argv[2] ?? '';
            $params = [];
            for ($i = 3; $i < count($argv); $i++) {
                [$k, $v] = explode('=', $argv[$i], 2);
                $params[$k] = $v;
            }
            
            $payload = $builder->buildQuery($templateName, $params);
            $client = new GraphQLClient($creds['endpoint'], $creds['token']);
            $result = $client->execute($payload);
            echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n";
            return 0;
            
        case 'inline':
            $creds = $store->loadCredentials();
            if (empty($creds)) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "No credentials configured.\n");
                return 1;
            }
            
            $allowedFields = ['user', 'users', 'items', 'item', 'categories'];
            $processor = new InlineQueryProcessor($allowedFields);
            
            $operation = $argv[2] ?? 'query';
            $fields = $argv[3] ?? '';
            
            // Parse inline args from remaining argv
            $inlineArgs = [];
            for ($i = 4; $i < count($argv); $i++) {
                [$k, $v] = explode('=', $argv[$i], 2);
                $inlineArgs[$k] = $v;
            }
            
            $query = $processor->processInlineQuery($operation, $fields, $inlineArgs);
            $payload = ['query' => $query];
            
            $client = new GraphQLClient($creds['endpoint'], $creds['token']);
            $result = $client->execute($payload);
            echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n";
            return 0;
            
        default:
            echo "Usage: gqlcli [configure|query|inline] [args...]\n";
            return 0;
    }
}

exit(main($argv));
